summary.text: Jim Hoops is serving his fourth full term in the Ohio House, representing District 81, which includes Fulton, Williams, and Henry counties and the northern portion of Defiance County. He chairs the House Development Committee.

paragraphs.text: Hoops graduated from Patrick Henry High School in 1977 and earned a Bachelor of Science degree in Business and Computer Programming at Northwest State University of Louisiana.
He served as Henry County Auditor from 1985 to 1998 and in the Ohio House from 1999 to 2006.

Hoops worked for American Municipal Power, Inc. from 2007 to 2014 as Associate VP of Finance, and for Northwest State Community College from 2015 to 2018 as Associate Vice President for Strategic Initiatives.
He was appointed to the House during the 132nd General Assembly and was elected majority whip for the 135th General Assembly.
In the 136th General Assembly he also serves on the Commerce and Labor, Community Revitalization, and Finance committees.
Hoops volunteers for the United Way of Henry County, and he and his wife, Deb, live in Napoleon.
